categories.snippet: הכתב עוסק במפעלו האינטלקטואלי המלא של הדמות הנחקרת, כאשר לפי הנחיות כתב העת המבוקש יש להתמקד ביצירה אחת בלבד
categories.note: The venue's genre convention (see venue.md) calls for focus on a single work; this paragraph explicitly describes covering the full body of work instead, a direct venue/genre mismatch.
categories.fixWith: Narrow the article's scope to one work, or submit to a venue whose genre convention accepts a full-corpus survey.

categories.snippet: לאורך הדיון מופיע המושג "מהפכנות דתית" פעמים רבות כהנחת יסוד לטיעון, בלי שהמאמר מגדיר אותו
categories.note: 'מהפכנות דתית' (religious revolutionism) is used repeatedly as a load-bearing premise but is never defined or distinguished from adjacent terms, so a reader cannot evaluate the argument that depends on it.
categories.fixWith: Add an explicit working definition of the term on first use, and distinguish it from the neighboring terms the paragraph names.

categories.planLabel: insider references a general reader can't follow
categories.snippet: הדיון מזכיר בקצרה את "הוועדה מן הישיבה השכונתית שדנה בנושא ב-1998" מבלי לפרט מיהם חבריה
categories.note: The reference to an unnamed local committee and an undated protocol assumes background knowledge a general journal reader does not have and cannot look up.
categories.fixWith: Either drop the reference or add enough context (who convened it, what it decided, where the record is public) for an outside reader to follow it.

categories.snippet: בשלב זה מבקש הכותב לחזור ולהיזכר כיצד פגש לראשונה, לפני כעשרים שנה, את מי שעליו נסוב המחקר
categories.note: A first-person recollection of a personal meeting that shaped the author's attitude to the subject; this is memoir material, not part of the research argument, and reads as epilogue drift mid-article.
categories.fixWith: Cut the anecdote, or move it to an author's-note / acknowledgments section clearly separated from the research argument.

categories.snippet: הפרק המסכם עובר לטון של כתבת תחקיר עיתונאית, עם ציטוטים לא מתועדים ותיאור אירועים בזמן עבר מיידי
categories.note: The closing section shifts into an investigative-journalism register (undocumented quotations, immediate-past narration) instead of returning to the theoretical framework the article opened with.
categories.fixWith: Rewrite the closing section to re-anchor the findings in the article's own theoretical framework, and cite or drop the undocumented quotations.

_provenance: The five CATEGORIES and the venue's 'what they reject' list are taken from the journal editor's actual rejection letter, so they are ground truth for what this venue rejects. The ANCHOR LINES are invented fixture prose in excerpt.md, not the real article's sentences — the article is unpublished and its text is not committed here. So a hit means the editor agent found the right CATEGORY in the right place in the fixture; it does not mean it reproduced the editor's wording.

_letterEvidence.genre-fit: Asked for a focus on one book or article, or a small number of works; the submission treated the thinker's thought as a whole, per its own stated aim.
_letterEvidence.term-undefined: Loaded terms such as conservative morality, liberal morality and 'the true God' used without definition, with sweeping normative claims presented as starting points and an unsupported one-sentence claim about the essence and purpose of halakha.
_letterEvidence.insider-reference: Substantial parts rely on familiarity with a specific religious community's internal distinctions; the editors state readers should not need to know them.
_letterEvidence.cut: Personal acquaintance with the subject, biographical episodes, and an epilogue about the author's relationship with him — meaningful personally, not matter for the journal's readers.
_letterEvidence.refocus: A topic already argued at length in the press, carried over without the research framing the journal requires; likewise a question currently preoccupying a particular public.
